name: The Ember
flavour: The Ember never quite goes out. Patience is a kind of fire.
text: The Ember keeps them burning: your burns, poison, slows, freezes and stuns last 20% longer a level.
art_prompt: a coiled black fuse cord burning at one end with a bright orange spark and a small curl of grey smoke

B.note: B · tilted card (detail: the least: flat colours, one symbol, nothing else)

recipe.subject: One single fortune-teller tarot card standing upright and tilted about 12 degrees clockwise, filling the picture from top to bottom, seen straight on. The card has a thick cream parchment border with rounded corners and a thin dark brown line just inside it and a deep brown-black face. One huge bold symbol fills almost the whole face: one big glowing orange ember coal with a small steady flame curling up from it, in orange, red and black.
